7 feet tall, 600 pounds, massively obese, bat-winged servant of the titans. Furry, roughly human-shaped generals of the thanatotic armies. Demonic in origin.

AC 14, HP 57, ATK 4 +2 mace +8 (1d6+2) or 2 spell +8, MV double near (fly), S +4, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +3, AL C, LV 12

Baffle (INT Spell). Focus. DC 15. All foes within double near can't take actions and move in a random direction on their turn.

Balefire (INT Spell). DC 15. 5d6 damage to one target within far.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by magic sources. Weapons dissolve if slain.

Void Shunt (INT Spell). DC 15. Plane shift self and all within double near to the Abyss or mortal world.
